quote: It is a misdemeanor for any person willfully to fail or refuse to comply with any lawful order or direction of any police officer while the officer is performing the duties of the officer in the enforcement of chapters 484A to 484E, inclusive, of NRS.

activation.condition: A police officer performing traffic-enforcement duties gives a lawful order or direction addressed to the person.

obligation.description: Comply with the lawful order or direction; willful failure or refusal is the prohibited conduct.

timing.description: Indication precedes enough subsequent subject motion to observe response.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: willfully to fail or refuse to comply with any lawful order or direction
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original officer indication and subsequent subject motion are measurable; officer duty, order lawfulness and willfulness require independent source and legal review.

parameter_refs.name: intended_observed_response
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: observable response or nonresponse after indication; no willfulness inference
